notes: The two remaining groups are NOT a defect. The booklet really builds two separate models: the snake-bog hideout (pages 3-9, b1-b13) and the ATV (pages 10-21, b14 onward). They are separate sub-builds that never attach, so the graph is intentionally two components. I left this as is and added no invented connection between them.

The banknote tiles (b12, b13) go into the backpack on page 2 and the bag on page 9. The bag rests on the hideout there, so they are modelled as touching each other and resting on slope b4 (contact edges). The backpack is a minifigure part and not a node.
Minifigures are not in the parts list so they are not nodes.

Stud positions on the 4x4 wedge plate (rows/columns), the exact placement of the 1x2 plates on the hideout, and the overlap of the 2x4 plate with the wedge are inferred from small pictures. Port indices are best guesses.

ATV clip plates: b19 and b20 sit on the rear mudguard studs, b21 and b22 stack on them. The yellow handle tile (windscreen) is clipped by b21. The taps stand on the studs of b21 and b22. The handcuffs clip to b22. The grille tile b23 is placed on the rear mudguard.

Step 14: the bar holder with clip (b34) clips on the yellow tile's handle and holds the 3L bar. The last page shows the minifigure holding this bar with the snake, so it is later removed from the ATV. The snake is modelled as resting on the bar holder.

Wheel holder plates have no pin ports in the catalogue, so wheel-to-plate joins use a null port on the plate. The 60470b plate is assumed to clip onto the side handles of 48336. The handlebar pin to clip is a pin/clip join.
Money tiles are Green 3069bpr0100 per the parts list. Page 23 shows a different element number.
